summary: Offers guidelines for authors and reviewers of standards-track documents that define YANG data models, the modeling language used with NETCONF. The aim is better interoperability and usability. It is informational and was replaced by RFC 8407.

eli5.summary: A checklist for people who write and check the blueprints that describe how network gear is configured, so the blueprints all look alike and work together.

questions: how to review a yang data model
